hypothesis: Two heads without a closed candidate-concept list provide complementary patient attribution: exact canonical-name set generation and exact-quote grounded generation. Their literal agreement may add reliable relations beyond the current three-source consensus.
formula: Complete current two_of_three baseline UNION (all canonical_names relations INTERSECT all grounded relations)
selection: All literal patient-HPO agreements used; no subset, confidence threshold, source replacement or patient selection. Names supply HPO only; old baseline NIL and all other relations retained.
source_training: Canonical name and grounded heads both train32 F2/F3; upstream baseline/source provenance already audited. No new task-model fit in this control.
quality: Per fold one complete prediction frozen before one v2 all/text, old0; if no new relations, exact equality conclusion and no redundant score. Originaldev/official not authorized by this decision.
comparison: Strictly above the complete current two_of_three baseline, not the weaker initial B. Both folds are development.
independent_canonical_endpoint: Existing owner one-shot B471 union canonical result remains separate; this formula will not be selected or altered based on that result.
